propositions: The transition command has two separate force flags with different meanings: --force (start-work/plan-review gate bypass) and --force-close (completion-verification gate bypass), creating ambiguity and inconsistency with the claim command's --force flag.

--force-close should be renamed to --force with context-dependent behavior: bypassing the start-work gate on open->in_progress transitions and the completion gate on close transitions, collapsing two separate flags into one.
The parser must explicitly reject the retired --force-close flag spelling with a CommandError rather than silently skipping it to prevent stale callers from unexpectedly bypassing gates.

A bare --force on a close transition must record (no reason given) as the audit reason, matching claim command behavior, while --force=<reason> and --force --reason=X preserve existing audit note semantics on open->in_progress transitions.
